excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的矿脉资源十分丰富。

不幸的是，其中大部分矿石对我们都没用。然而，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为[From.GetName]地壳中的许多元素都可以通过正电子轰炸转化成对我方有用的矿石。

[Root.GetName]希望[Root.Owner.GetName]能拨出1000能量币实行此计划。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] is exceptionally rich in minerals.

Minerals that are, unfortunately, of no use to us. However, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes the many elements in the crust of [From.GetName] can be transformed into potentially more useful forms

label.en: Very well, ready the positron charges.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的矿脉资源十分丰富。

不幸的是，其中大部分矿石对我们都没用。然而，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为[From.GetName]地壳中的许多元素都可以通过正电子轰炸转化成对我方有用的矿石。

[Root.GetName]希望[Root.Owner.GetName]能拨出1000能量币实行此计划。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is exceptionally rich in minerals.

Minerals that are, unfortunately, of no use to us. However, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes the many elements in the crust of [From.GetName] can be transformed into potentially more useful forms through positron bombardment.

The [Root.GetName] has requests that the [Root.Owner.GetName] set aside 1000 Energy Credits for the purposes of this project.

label.en: Very well, ready the positron charges.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员们汇报了试验的成功。[From.From.GetName]上的许多矿脉现在都可以被我们所使用了。
texts.en: The crew of the [Root.GetName] are pleased to report that the experiment was a success, and a significant number of dense mineral veins on [From.From.GetName] have been transmuted into usable resources.

texts.zh: 在轨可控阳电子扩散法也许可以将星球原有的矿物质变成一种更有用的形式。
texts.en: Controlled dispersal of positrons from orbit may change the minerals native to the planet into a more useful form.
